title: GPOM Choruses: the humans
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ the choruses, with people
moodboard_intro: Round 2: three new camera angles on each of your 12 picks: the same place, people and light, framed so they can be intercut with the pick. Your picks are in the strip at the top. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per beat.
storyboard_intro: Frames in story order. Pick one still and one way to animate each.

empty: chorus 2 today: the beam over the town

beats.name: The trader, a week later
beats.blurb: The man from the trading desk in the opening, after the sackings.

beats.name: The woman and the loaf
beats.blurb: The woman from the corner shop in the opening. Now she can't pay for the bread.

beats.name: The doorway
beats.blurb: One of the sacked office workers, sleeping in the doorway of the tower that sacked him.

beats.name: Who gained
beats.blurb: The tower lit up and busy with nobody at a desk, or the boardroom toasting over the queue. The beneficiary and the cost in one frame.

beats.name: The money stops
beats.blurb: First pass: cash machines dead, the bank's shutter down.

beats.name: The lights stutter
beats.blurb: A terraced street at dusk, people at windows and on doorsteps.

beats.name: Everyone leaves
beats.blurb: Second pass: the M4 out of Swindon jammed at night. Sets up the war's empty M4.

beats.name: Looking back
beats.blurb: The glow over town, seen from a back seat. Fire only as a glow.

beats.name: Far off
beats.blurb: A helicopter's light spiralling down in the distance, tiny and silent (Kai's idea).

beats.name: Something in the sky
beats.blurb: Faces turned up at lights we don't see: the drones arriving.

beats.name: The town goes dark
beats.blurb: Swindon losing power district by district.

beats.name: Gone
beats.blurb: Last frame before black: nobody left. A car door open, engine running. Then black, then the war's grey morning.
